name: Chole masala
storage: Room temperature, in an airtight jar away from the stove, sunlight and steam. Use within 3–4 months of opening for best aroma. Always use a dry spoon.
looksLike: A dark brown, fairly coarse powder sold in small cartons or pouches. It smells roasted and sour because it usually holds dried pomegranate seed (anardana) or amchur along with coriander, cumin, black cardamom, cloves and chilli.
shelfLife: Typically 9–12 months unopened (see the pack date).
substitutes: Garam masala + amchur (about 3:1) + a pinch of chilli
Pav bhaji or chana masala-style blends from the same brand
Homemade roasted blend (coriander, cumin, black cardamom, cloves, anardana, amchur)
mergeNotes: Range 680.0–920.0 was wider than 30% of avg 800.0; narrowed to ±15%.
